name: diagram-pane
description: A side pane of file-backed diagrams: every diagram Claude draws is pinned to a mermaid file in ~/.claude/workmaps, editable by anyone, folding to one line in the transcript, with click anchors that open the code a box stands for

everyTurns.title: Map every N turns
everyTurns.description: How many turns between work-map checks (the Haiku gate runs, then a fork only if the work changed shape)

maxPins.title: Pinned diagrams kept
maxPins.description: How many pinned diagrams the pane keeps, newest first (files stay on disk even when they leave the pane)
